quizzes.title: Who invented the telephone?
quizzes.description_html: Pick the best answer. You can embed an image with <img src="https://example.com/photo.jpg"> or upload files in the editor after import.
quizzes.explanation_html: Alexander Graham Bell is credited with the first practical telephone (1876).

options.feedback_html: Edison improved many things — not this one.

quizzes.title: A second quiz in the same file
quizzes.description_html: You can put many quizzes in one JSON file. Each must have exactly four options and exactly one is_correct: true.
